investigations.name: origins-of-life-vent
investigations.title: Origins-of-life vent campaign
investigations.question: Could the first cells have originated at alkaline hydrothermal vents — and where does the geology-to-cells path run continuously, where does it depend on narrow regimes, and where does it break? Can a physically plausible early-Earth vent–ocean interface generate and sustain, in order, the free energy, reduced carbon, persistent network chemistry, concentration, and compartments a protocell needs — without inserting metabolism, membranes, autocatalysis, or heredity by assumption?
investigations.hypothesis: Under field- and lab-consistent parameter ranges, a serpentinization-fed, spatially resolved alkaline vent reproduces the conditions for a cellular origin: it crosses, in order, falsifiable thresholds for sustained carbon fixation, network persistence, concentration/individuality, compartmentation, internalized energy, and heritable organization — with identifiable parameter regions where each step fails.
